messages:
Morgan (People Ops): Diego — dropping a short, copyable first-week sprint + a measurable 30/60/90 you can paste into the offer and calendar invites. Keep it lean. :sparkles:

Morgan (People Ops): FIRST-WEEK SPRINT (calendar friendly):
Day -1: 1Password, SSO/MFA, Slack/email created, hardware shipping confirmed
Day 0: 15m welcome, buddy intro (Kai), quick infra tour (30m)
Day 1: Local dev + repo sync with buddy (2h), access checklist (model store, logs)
Day 2: Pair on an onboarding-safe issue, CI run walkthrough (1h)
Day 3: Observability & tracing demo (30m), small doc or metric task assigned
Day 4: Ship first small PR, staging verification, 1:1 recap and 30/60/90 draft

Morgan (People Ops): MANAGER CHECKLIST (week 1):
- Post intro in #company + #eng-runtime (include pronouns + fun fact)
- Confirm buddy assigned and first pairing scheduled
- Create a labeled onboarding-safe issue and pre-assign reviewers
- Block weekly 1:1s for first 6 weeks and schedule 30-day retro
- Ensure security training and KMS/GCS access requests submitted

Morgan (People Ops): 30/60/90 (runtime-focused, measurable):
- 30 days: dev env + infra access complete; 1 merged PR that fixes a small infra bug or doc gap (AC: CI green, reviewer sign-off, staging deploy checked)
- 60 days: own a small component and ship a measurable change (AC: metric or alert improvement, updated runbook)
- 90 days: lead rollout of an optimization and take primary on an oncall rotation (AC: runbook updated, post-rollout review, no P0 regressions in 2 weeks)

Diego (Eng Manager): Nice and succinct. Can you add who to ping for Dedicated GPU dev quota and KMS access?

Morgan (People Ops): Sure — eng-infra for GPU quotas (ticket prefix: onboard-gpu), Security for KMS/HSM (ticket prefix: onboard-kms), IT Support for hardware & VPN. OnboardingBot will DM training reminders.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled — Security Basics will DM Zoe on day 1; Data Handling on day 8. Targets: basic by EOD day 3, full by day 14.

Zoe (New Hire): Laptop tracker shows "label created"  any ETA? Also where do I find starter issues?

IT Support: Hi Zoe  carrier delay, ETA ~24-48h. Please DM preferred delivery window if you need earlier. Starter issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/onboarding-safe (pinned in #eng-runtime).

Kai (Buddy): Zoe  I'll DM you an invite for a 2h pairing block on Day 1 and a 30-min repo tour. I'll add two safe PRs to the onboarding board so you can pick one.

Diego (Eng Manager): I'll draft a one-line intro for #company: "Zoe joins as a Runtime Engineer focused on serving perf. Fun fact: urban gardener. Welcome Zoe!" Will post Monday. Also scheduling weekly 1:1s and a 30-day retro on Friday week 2.

Morgan (People Ops): Copyable calendar titles: "Welcome Zoe — Runtime 1:1", "Pairing: local setup with Kai", "30-day retrospective". Attach fillable 30/60/90 to the invites and include acceptance criteria bullets.

Zoe (New Hire): Thanks all  confirmed pronouns via DM. Appreciate the clear plan. One last: who approves short-term Dedicated GPU access?

eng-infra: Raise an eng-infra ticket with prefix "onboard-gpu" and CC Diego. We'll fast-track a 30-day dev quota (default 1 GPU) once reviewed.

Morgan (People Ops): Closing note: if anything blocks hardware or access, prefix tickets with "onboard-urgent" and tag IT Support + eng-infra. Happy to iterate on role-specific 30/60/90s if you want more exact metrics. :white_check_mark:
